```{r}
seeds <- 1:200

# ── Generate data storing raw min/max BEFORE normalization ────────────────
double_sig_data <- vector("list", length(seeds))
data_scales     <- vector("list", length(seeds))

for (i in seq_along(seeds)) {
  set.seed(seeds[i])
  
  x_vals     <- seq(0, 300, by = 20)
  x_repeated <- rep(x_vals, each = 5)
  
  x_dense  <- seq(0, 300, length.out = 1000)
  f0_vals  <- f0(x_dense, 0.04, 110, 0.03, 240)
  argument <- x_dense[which.max(f0_vals)]
  const    <- f0(argument, 0.04, 110, 0.03, 240)
  y_true   <- f2_h0(x_repeated, 20, 750, 400, 0.04, 110, 0.03, 240, const, argument)
  y_noisy  <- rnorm(length(y_true), mean = y_true, sd = 10)
  
  raw_int_min <- min(y_noisy)
  raw_int_max <- max(y_noisy)
  
  data_scales[[i]] <- tibble(
    seed    = seeds[i],
    int_min = raw_int_min,
    int_max = raw_int_max
  )
  
  double_sig_data[[i]] <- tibble(
    time      = (x_repeated - min(x_repeated)) / (max(x_repeated) - min(x_repeated)),
    intensity = (y_noisy    - raw_int_min)      / (raw_int_max     - raw_int_min)
  )
}

data_scales <- bind_rows(data_scales)
print(data_scales)

# define bounds
bounds <- matrix(c(-0.10,  0.30, 0.00,   0.01,   0.01,  -0.52, -0.48,
                    0.30,  0.97, 1.00, 180.00, 180.00,   1.15,  1.79),
                 nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)

run_woa_parallel <- function(data, i, algo_func, algo_name) {
  out <- algo_func(data)
  out$dataset_id <- i
  out$seed       <- seeds[i]
  out$algorithm  <- algo_name
  out
}
```

```{r}
# set up multicores
plan(multisession, workers = 5)

# ── True parameters (raw scale) ────────────────────────────────────────────
true_params_double <- c(h0 = 20, h1 = 750, h2 = 400,
                        a1 = 0.04, a2 = 0.03,
                        t1 = 110,  t2 = 240)

# ── Residual function for LMA inside hybrid ────────────────────────────────
double_sig_residual <- function(params, data) {
  predicted <- double_sig_fit_formula(
    data$time,
    params[1], params[2], params[3],
    params[4], params[5], params[6], params[7]
  )
  data$intensity - predicted
}

# ── WOA-LMA Hybrid runner for double sigmoidal ─────────────────────────────
run_hybrid_double <- function(data, i,
                              numPopulation = 40,
                              max_iter_woa  = 500) {
  result <- woa_lma_hybrid(
    FUN           = function(x) objective_SSE_double(x, data),
    residual_fn   = function(x) double_sig_residual(x, data),
    numVar        = ncol(bounds),
    rangeVar      = bounds,
    numPopulation = numPopulation,
    max_iter_woa  = max_iter_woa,
    div_threshold = 0.05,
    n_lma         = 10,
    min_dist      = 0.01,
    verbose       = FALSE
  )
  list(
    h0         = result$par[1],
    h1         = result$par[2],
    h2         = result$par[3],
    a1         = result$par[4],
    a2         = result$par[5],
    t1         = result$par[6],
    t2         = result$par[7],
    best_sse   = result$value,
    dataset_id = i,
    seed       = seeds[i],
    algorithm  = "WOA-LMA Hybrid"
  )
}

# ── Run all four algorithms ────────────────────────────────────────────────
epsilon <- 0.01
a_min   <- 0.01
a_max   <- 180

options(future.rng.onMisuse = "ignore")
tic.clearlog()

tic("WOA")
double_woa_df <- future_map2_dfr(
  double_sig_data, seq_along(double_sig_data),
  ~ run_woa_parallel(.x, .y, run_WOA_double, "WOA"),
  seed = TRUE
)
toc(log = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

tic("WOA Lévy")
double_levy_df <- future_map2_dfr(
  double_sig_data, seq_along(double_sig_data),
  ~ run_woa_parallel(.x, .y, run_WOA_levy_double, "WOA Lévy"),
  seed = TRUE
)
toc(log = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

tic("WOA-LMA Hybrid")
double_hybrid_df <- future_map2_dfr(
  double_sig_data, seq_along(double_sig_data),
  ~ run_hybrid_double(.x, .y),
  seed = TRUE
)
toc(log = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

tic("LMA with random starts")
double_lma_df <- future_map2_dfr(
  double_sig_data,
  seq_along(double_sig_data),
  ~ run_lma_fit_double(.x, dataset_id = .y, seed = seeds[.y]),
  seed = TRUE
)
toc(log = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

# ── Combine results ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
results_double <- bind_rows(
  double_woa_df,
  double_levy_df,
  double_hybrid_df,
  double_lma_df |> mutate(algorithm = "LMA with random starts")
)

# ── Flag failed runs and compute l2 norm ──────────────────────────────────
results_double <- results_double |>
  left_join(data_scales, by = "seed") |>
  mutate(
    best_sse = if_else(best_sse >= 1e10, NA_real_, best_sse),
    true_h0  = (true_params_double["h0"] - int_min) / (int_max - int_min),
    true_h1  = (true_params_double["h1"] - int_min) / (int_max - int_min),
    true_h2  = (true_params_double["h2"] - int_min) / (int_max - int_min),
    true_a1  = (true_params_double["a1"] - a_min)   / (a_max - a_min),
    true_a2  = (true_params_double["a2"] - a_min)   / (a_max - a_min),
    true_t1  = true_params_double["t1"] / 300,
    true_t2  = true_params_double["t2"] / 300,
    a1_norm  = (a1 - a_min) / (a_max - a_min),
    a2_norm  = (a2 - a_min) / (a_max - a_min),
    l2_norm  = sqrt(
      (h0 - true_h0)^2 +
      (h1 - true_h1)^2 +
      (h2 - true_h2)^2 +
      (a1_norm - true_a1)^2 +
      (a2_norm - true_a2)^2 +
      (t1 - true_t1)^2 +
      (t2 - true_t2)^2
    )
  ) |>
  select(-c(int_min, int_max, a1_norm, a2_norm,
            true_h0, true_h1, true_h2, true_a1, true_a2, true_t1, true_t2))

# quick check
# results_double |>
#   select(seed, algorithm, h0, h1, h2, t1, t2, l2_norm) |>
#   filter(seed == 1)

# ── Summary table ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_algs_double_df <- results_double |>
  group_by(algorithm) |>
  summarise(
    mean_obj_value   = mean(best_sse,   na.rm = TRUE),
    median_obj_value = median(best_sse, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_obj_value    = min(best_sse,    na.rm = TRUE),
    max_obj_value    = max(best_sse,    na.rm = TRUE),
    n_failed         = sum(is.na(best_sse)),
    n_under_epsilon  = sum(best_sse < epsilon, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_param_acc   = mean(l2_norm,   na.rm = TRUE),
    median_param_acc = median(l2_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_param_acc    = min(l2_norm,    na.rm = TRUE),
    max_param_acc    = max(l2_norm,    na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# ── Timing table ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
timing_double <- tic.log(format = FALSE) |>
  map_dfr(~ tibble(
    algorithm = .x$msg,
    time_sec  = .x$toc - .x$tic
  ))

time_per_seed_double <- timing_double |>
  mutate(time_sec = time_sec / length(seeds))
colnames(time_per_seed_double) <- c("Algorithm", "Time (sec)")
```


```{r}
results_double <- bind_rows(
  double_woa_df,
  double_levy_df,
  double_hybrid_df,
  double_lma_df |> mutate(algorithm = "LMA with random starts")
) |>
  select(-any_of(c("int_min", "int_max", "l2_norm"))) |>
  left_join(data_scales, by = "seed") |>
  mutate(
    best_sse = if_else(best_sse >= 1e10, NA_real_, best_sse),
    true_h0  = (true_params_double["h0"] - int_min) / (int_max - int_min),
    true_h1  = (true_params_double["h1"] - int_min) / (int_max - int_min),
    true_h2  = (true_params_double["h2"] - int_min) / (int_max - int_min),
    true_a1  = true_params_double["a1"] * 300,
    true_a2  = true_params_double["a2"] * 300,
    true_t1  = true_params_double["t1"] / 300,
    true_t2  = true_params_double["t2"] / 300,
    l2_norm  = sqrt(
      (h0 - true_h0)^2 +
      (h1 - true_h1)^2 +
      (h2 - true_h2)^2 +
      (a1 - true_a1)^2 +
      (a2 - true_a2)^2 +
      (t1 - true_t1)^2 +
      (t2 - true_t2)^2
    )
  ) |>
  select(-c(int_min, int_max,
            true_h0, true_h1, true_h2, true_a1, true_a2, true_t1, true_t2))

# verify — a1 should be close to 12, a2 close to 9 for good algorithms
results_double |>
  filter(seed == 1) |>
  select(algorithm, a1, a2, t1, t2, l2_norm)

all_algs_double_df <- results_double |>
  group_by(algorithm) |>
  summarise(
    mean_obj_value   = mean(best_sse,   na.rm = TRUE),
    median_obj_value = median(best_sse, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_obj_value    = min(best_sse,    na.rm = TRUE),
    max_obj_value    = max(best_sse,    na.rm = TRUE),
    n_failed         = sum(is.na(best_sse)),
    n_under_epsilon  = sum(best_sse < epsilon, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_param_acc   = mean(l2_norm,   na.rm = TRUE),
    median_param_acc = median(l2_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_param_acc    = min(l2_norm,    na.rm = TRUE),
    max_param_acc    = max(l2_norm,    na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

# sequence instead of parallel

```{r}
# ── Test run: sequential ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
seeds <- 1:3  # small batch to verify

double_sig_data <- map(seeds, function(s) {
  set.seed(s)
  generate_piecewise_data()
})

bounds <- matrix(c(-0.10,  0.30, 0.00,   0.01,   0.01,  -0.52, -0.48,
                    0.30,  0.97, 1.00, 180.00, 180.00,   1.15,  1.79),
                 nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)

true_params_double <- c(h0 = 20, h1 = 750, h2 = 400,
                        a1 = 0.04, a2 = 0.03,
                        t1 = 110,  t2 = 240)

double_sig_residual <- function(params, data) {
  predicted <- double_sig_fit_formula(
    data$time,
    params[1], params[2], params[3],
    params[4], params[5], params[6], params[7]
  )
  data$intensity - predicted
}

run_hybrid_double <- function(data, i,
                              numPopulation = 40,
                              max_iter_woa  = 500) {
  out <- withSeed({
    result <- woa_lma_hybrid(
      FUN           = function(x) objective_SSE_double(x, data),
      residual_fn   = function(x) double_sig_residual(x, data),
      numVar        = ncol(bounds),
      rangeVar      = bounds,
      numPopulation = numPopulation,
      max_iter_woa  = max_iter_woa,
      div_threshold = 0.05,
      n_lma         = 10,
      min_dist      = 0.01,
      verbose       = FALSE
    )
    list(
      h0       = result$par[1],
      h1       = result$par[2],
      h2       = result$par[3],
      a1       = result$par[4],
      a2       = result$par[5],
      t1       = result$par[6],
      t2       = result$par[7],
      best_sse = result$value
    )
  }, seed = seeds[i])

  out$dataset_id <- i
  out$seed       <- seeds[i]
  out$algorithm  <- "WOA-LMA Hybrid"
  out
}

# ── Sequential runs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tic.clearlog()

tic("WOA")
double_woa_df <- map2_dfr(
  double_sig_data, seq_along(double_sig_data),
  ~ run_woa_parallel(.x, .y, run_WOA_double, "WOA")
)
toc(log = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
message("WOA done: ", nrow(double_woa_df), " rows")

tic("WOA Lévy")
double_levy_df <- map2_dfr(
  double_sig_data, seq_along(double_sig_data),
  ~ run_woa_parallel(.x, .y, run_WOA_levy_double, "WOA Lévy")
)
toc(log = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
message("WOA Lévy done: ", nrow(double_levy_df), " rows")

tic("WOA-LMA Hybrid")
double_hybrid_df <- map2_dfr(
  double_sig_data, seq_along(double_sig_data),
  ~ run_hybrid_double(.x, .y)
)
toc(log = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
message("WOA-LMA Hybrid done: ", nrow(double_hybrid_df), " rows")

tic("LMA with random starts")
double_lma_df <- map2_dfr(
  double_sig_data, seq_along(double_sig_data),
  ~ run_lma_fit_double(.x, dataset_id = .y, seed = seeds[.y])
) |>
  mutate(algorithm = "LMA with random starts")  # fix internal label
toc(log = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
message("LMA done: ", nrow(double_lma_df), " rows")

# ── Combine ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
results_double <- bind_rows(
  double_woa_df,
  double_levy_df,
  double_hybrid_df,
  double_lma_df
)

# quick sanity check
message("Total rows: ", nrow(results_double))
message("Algorithms present: ", paste(unique(results_double$algorithm), collapse = ", "))
message("Any NA best_sse: ", sum(is.na(results_double$best_sse)))
print(results_double)
```
